snippet.title: Meet Thomas the Tank Engine  | Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor – Out Now!
snippet.description:
Introducing Thomas the Tank Engine 💙  

Thomas is a cheeky little engine, and he often gets into scrapes, usually by being over-eager to do things best left to bigger engines. But clouds never last long in Thomas’ world and soon he’s bustling about again, playing his part in the railway. He loves having new adventures and meeting new friends. 

Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of  Sodor is out  now on Steam, Epic Games, PlayStation and Xbox via https://bit.ly/Wonders-Of-Sodor-Launch-4

Nintendo Switch is coming soon.
